answer_1.quote: We evaluate our training approach across various architectures. Specifically, we conduct experiments using two language models-FiD and CEPE-Llama2-7B -as well as two rerankers-BGE-Reranker-Base and RankT5. Our method is tested on five benchmark datasets, covering both single-hop and multi-hop QA tasks.
